h1: SS-31 (elamipretide) peptide: the trials behind the 2025 approval, the trials that missed, and what the gray-market use rests on
dek: SS-31 is the research name of an approved medicine. This page lines up every trial with its dose and result, including the two large ones that missed their primary endpoints, explains what the Barth syndrome approval does and does not cover, and says what the longevity use has behind it: one trial in older adults with a transient effect.

queries.heading: What people report outside the literature
queries.boundary: Forum reports describe use for energy, longevity and recovery, none of which has been tested in a trial. The 2021 older-adult trial is the closest thing to that use, and it found a transient effect on muscle energetics and none on fatigue.

queries.boundary: MOTS-c and humanin are mitochondrial-derived peptides made by the body; SS-31 is a synthetic drug that binds a mitochondrial lipid. No study has compared or combined them.

queries.heading: What is the half-life of SS-31?
queries.answer: Short, measured in hours. The 2021 trial in older adults found the effect of a single two-hour infusion on muscle energetics had gone by day 7 and called that consistent with elamipretide's half-life in human blood; the trials and the label therefore use once-daily subcutaneous injection. No abstract in the ledger states the figure, so this page does not.

queries.heading: What is SS-31?
queries.answer: SS-31 is the research name of elamipretide, a four-amino-acid synthetic peptide that concentrates in the inner mitochondrial membrane and binds cardiolipin. It was developed as Bendavia and MTP-131 by Stealth BioTherapeutics and, since 19 September 2025, is an FDA-approved medicine, Forzinity, for muscle strength in Barth syndrome. Vials sold as 'SS-31 peptide' are the same molecule from unregulated suppliers.

queries.heading: Does SS-31 work as eye drops?
queries.answer: A 1% topical solution was tested for 52 weeks in 12 people with Leber hereditary optic neuropathy. It was well tolerated but visual acuity did not differ from the vehicle-treated eyes; a post hoc visual-field measure favoured treatment. Company trials in dry macular degeneration (ReCLAIM-2) missed their primary endpoints, per public reports; those papers are not in the ledger.

queries.heading: Can SS-31 help with weight loss?
queries.answer: No trial has measured weight or fat as an outcome, and none was designed to. Elamipretide's trials measured walking distance, fatigue, muscle strength, heart volumes and mitochondrial ATP production. The metabolic reputation belongs to MOTS-c, a different peptide, and is untested for SS-31.

queries.heading: How was SS-31 given in the trials?
queries.answer: By subcutaneous injection once a day in every trial from MMPOWER-2 onward and on the approved label; by two-hour intravenous infusion in the first dose-finding trial and the older-adult trial; as 1% eye drops in the optic-neuropathy trial. Site selection and technique are on the Forzinity label, which this page does not reproduce.

queries.heading: Should SS-31 be taken with MOTS-c?
queries.answer: No study has tested the pair, in any order or in any species. The sequencing advice on forums is invented. Each compound's own record is the whole of what is known: SS-31 has randomized trials in mitochondrial disease; MOTS-c has small human studies and mouse work.

information_gain: The only page that tells the 'SS-31 peptide' searcher that the compound became a prescription medicine (Forzinity) on 19 September 2025 and what that approval rests on: a 12-patient crossover trial that missed its primary endpoints in the randomized phase, its open-label extension, and a natural-history comparison, granted as an accelerated approval; that tabulates all eleven human studies in the ledger with dose, route, duration and result, including MMPOWER-3 (218 patients, no effect on either primary endpoint) and the optic-neuropathy eye-drop trial (no effect on acuity); and that states the longevity use rests on one trial in 39 older adults in which a single infusion raised muscle ATP capacity for hours and did nothing for fatigue.
serp_format_rewarded: Evidence explainer. The highest-ranking non-vendor results are a forum post promising 'what the trials really showed' and a researcher PDF, so a trial-by-trial table with plain verdicts is the format the SERP is asking for.
open_actions: Add the Forzinity prescribing information (DailyMed, December 2025) to the ledger: indication, weight gate, strength, dose, warnings; pending_source until then.
Add PROGRESS-HF (heart failure, 2020) and ReCLAIM-2 (dry AMD) to the ledger; both are cited editorially as trials that missed their primary endpoints.
